title: Religion
blurb: Scripture and theology from the world's faiths.

planned.title: Genesis
planned.author: The Bible
planned.note: The Bible's first book — creation, the fall, the flood, and the patriarchs.

planned.title: The Bhagavad Gita
planned.note: On the eve of battle a warrior refuses to fight; a god answers him — act without grasping at the fruit of action.

planned.title: The Dhammapada
planned.author: Early Buddhist tradition
planned.note: The Buddha's path at its plainest: the mind makes the world, craving makes the suffering, and a way out exists.

planned.title: Confessions
planned.author: Saint Augustine
planned.note: Augustine's first true autobiography of a soul — sin, restlessness, and conversion, addressed to God.

planned.title: The City of God
planned.author: Saint Augustine
planned.note: Written as Rome fell — the eternal city of God set against the earthly city of men.

planned.title: Summa Theologica
planned.author: Thomas Aquinas
planned.note: Aquinas's towering synthesis of faith and reason — medieval theology's masterwork.

planned.title: The Enuma Elish
planned.author: Babylon
planned.note: The Babylonian creation epic — the world made from the body of a slain god.

planned.title: The Egyptian Book of the Dead
planned.author: Anonymous · Egypt
planned.note: Spells to guide the soul through the underworld — Egypt's map of death and judgment.

planned.title: The Rig Veda
planned.author: Anonymous
planned.note: The oldest scripture of India — hymns to the gods at the source of the whole tradition.

planned.title: The Upanishads
planned.author: Anonymous
planned.note: The fountainhead of Indian philosophy — the discovery that the self within and the ground of all being are one.

planned.title: The Lotus Sutra
planned.author: Mahayana Buddhist tradition
planned.note: The central scripture of Mahayana Buddhism — the promise that all beings may awaken.

planned.title: The Platform Sutra
planned.author: Huineng
planned.note: The founding text of Zen — Huineng's teaching that awakening is sudden and within.

planned.title: The Qur'an
planned.note: For Muslims the literal speech of God, and the standard of the Arabic language — the book that shaped a civilization.

planned.title: The Revival of the Religious Sciences
planned.author: Al-Ghazali
planned.note: Al-Ghazali put reason in its place and rescued faith through the inner life — the most influential Muslim after the Prophet.

planned.title: Religio Medici
planned.author: Sir Thomas Browne
planned.note: A physician's eloquent meditation on faith, doubt, and the mysteries of the self.

planned.title: The Imitation of Christ
planned.author: Thomas à Kempis
planned.note: The most read Christian devotional after the Bible — humility and the inner life.

planned.title: Ninety-Five Theses & Addresses
planned.author: Martin Luther
planned.note: The spark of the Reformation and Luther's founding manifestos.

planned.title: Sacred Writings I
planned.author: Confucian, Hebrew, Christian
planned.note: Confucian, Hebrew, and Christian scripture, set side by side.

planned.title: Sacred Writings II
planned.author: Buddhist, Hindu, Mohammedan
planned.note: Buddhist, Hindu, and Muslim scripture, set side by side.

planned.title: The Holy Bible
planned.author: King James Version
planned.note: The scriptures of Judaism and Christianity, whole — law, poetry, prophecy, and gospel.

planned.title: The Tanakh
planned.author: The Hebrew Bible
planned.note: The Hebrew Bible — Torah, Prophets, and Writings, the scripture of Judaism.

planned.title: The Talmud
planned.note: The central text of rabbinic Judaism — the law argued out across generations.

planned.title: The Hadith
planned.note: The recorded sayings and deeds of the Prophet Muhammad — Islam's second source after the Qur'an.
